title: Chapter 291: Split Into Two Groups
content:
Chapter 291: Split Into Two Groups

"Sister Xue, someone wants to become an emperor, and it's not far from us. Do we want to go and see it?"

Qin Feng looked at Lu Xue and asked.

Hearing this, Lu Xue stared into the distance and pondered for a moment.

"There will inevitably be some people with bad intentions in Emperor Cheng. If you want to take advantage of the situation, disputes will definitely be inevitable at that time."

Hearing this, Xiao Luo nodded.

"Indeed, the ancient battlefield is already hidden in crisis, and it may attract some terrifying things at that time."

"Sister Xue, why don't we go to the other side?"

Xiao Luo obviously means that he doesn't want to get into this muddy water.

It’s a pity that Lu Xue didn’t think so.

"You must be an extraordinary person to become an emperor in the ancient battlefield. The other party must have made sufficient preparations before he dared to attract the imperial disaster."

"We went over and acted according to the opportunity."

Upon hearing this, Xiao Luo and the others naturally chose to support Lu Xue.

Then the three of them no longer hesitated and went straight toward the distance.

At the same time, the source of the movement is a bit wrong.

"Damn it, it's over. Why did this cause the Emperor's Tribulation? I'm not ready yet!"

A short-haired boy looked at the terrifying clouds in the void, a little crazy.

The young man was holding a broken ancient shield that exuded a terrifying aura in his hand.

Just now, he had harvested this ancient shield that looked very extraordinary, but before he could be happy, a pure ability quickly flew out of the ancient shield and poured straight into his body.

The next moment, he, who was at the peak of the Immortal Saint Realm, attracted the Emperor's Tribulation.

Now, he only has two paths.

Either become emperor or die.

He looked at the terrifying catastrophe cloud in the void and then at the ancient shield in his hand. He could no longer hold it back and a clang.

The ancient shield was thrown to the ground, and a crisp sound burst out.

"Fuck, trash, whoever wants it, whoever wants it!"

The boy cursed angrily, then quickly sat cross-legged on the ground.

In just a moment, the boy's breath calmed down.

Now there is no other way, so I can only try my best to adjust my condition to the best.

As for whether he could successfully overcome the tribulation, he was not sure.

After all, it was really hasty.

At this moment, the ancient shield thrown to the ground in the distance suddenly trembled slightly. The next moment, the phantom of a hunchbacked old man slowly emerged from the ancient shield.

"Young man, I have to pass on my inheritance. If you don't thank me, why do you still insult me?"

The old man spoke slowly, his expression could not be seen.

Hearing the sound, the boy suddenly opened his eyes and looked at the old man in shock.

"Former, senior?"

After rubbing his eyes, he confirmed that it was not a dream. The boy turned sadness into joy and rushed forward, "Senior, help me, I just got this broken, no, this treasure, the emperor disaster will come."

"With my current foundation, the risk of becoming an emperor is too great, not to mention that this is an ancient battlefield. When I pass the tribulation, it will inevitably be my weakest time. At that time,"

He didn't say anything more.

I believe that the old man in front of me will definitely understand what he means.

However, the old man was not surprised at all, and just said indifferently: "If you can't even get through such a little difficulty, you won't deserve my inheritance."

"If you die, I can wait for the next one."

Hearing this, the boy was stunned for a long time.

"Damn it, I'm a fairy!"

Facing the boy's curse, the old man had no reaction, as if he was unconscious, slowly dissipating.

Soon, the scene returned to calm again.

There was no movement around.

Only the buzzing clouds in the void made the scene extremely depressing.

With a plop, the boy collapsed on the ground, his face full of regret.

I didn't expect that one day I would fall into such a thing.

Looking at some strange pits around him, he seemed to have suddenly understood something.

Looking up at the void, the boy's face became heavier.

This Tribulation Cloud is even more terrifying than I imagined. It must be the master of the Breaking Shield that did something!

"Are you really going to lose yourself?"

At this time, several figures had arrived here. From a distance, I suddenly saw the young man standing alone among the remains of the ruins.

Only one person?

"Sister Xue, look, that guy should be the one who wants to become an emperor."

Qin Feng pointed to the boy in the distance and said.

At this moment, the three of them hid in the darkness and silently stared at the boy in the distance.

Lu Xue nodded slightly and then looked around.

"We may not be the only one in the dark at this moment."

Hearing this, Qin Feng and Xiao Luo nodded.

At this moment, I don’t know how many pairs of eyes were staring at the boy in the dark.

I thought about it with my butt and knew that the boy must have had some great opportunity.

Killing and robbing people is no longer surprising in today's ancient battlefield.

After these three years, Lu Xue and others have basically understood that there must be many other entrances in the ancient battlefield.

Because they met many people who were not from the four ancient tribes.

I think this is what the Great Elder of the Xiao clan said.

"Sister Xue, what should we do?"

Xiao Luo asked.

"What should I do? It's naturally the mantis stalks the cicada and the oriole behind."

Before Lu Xue could speak, Qin Feng said with a wicked smile.

This is also the method they have been using for the past three years.

Although I am a little older, I often can’t get anything.

But the victory lies in stability.

At least not to suffer any losses.

However, Lu Xue shook her head slightly.

"This place is still a bit far from the center of the ancient battlefield, and ordinary Immortal Emperor realm powerhouses basically won't appear here."

“With our strength, we are definitely the top presence in this area.”

"So this time, we took the initiative."

Lu Xue changed her normal behavior and suddenly chose the first one to rush.

Hearing this, although Xiao Luo and the others were a little shocked, they nodded.

They are not three years ago now, but there is no need to be submissive.

Of course, Lu Xue did this not only because of her confidence in her own strength, but also because of her youth in the distance.

Judging from the boy's expression, what was obviously going on is going on.

At this time, the boy's expression looked as ugly as if he had eaten shit.

Feeling the strange aura around him, his heart suddenly sank to the bottom of the valley.

What should come and what should not come, are all here.

Taking a deep breath, the boy forced himself to calm down.

Think of a way, you can't die!

After pondering for a moment, the boy really thought of a solution.

"Damn it, that's all."

The young man walked straight to the ancient shield, and then suddenly kicked the ancient shield in front of him to a distance of 108,000 miles.

This kick, the boy almost used his twelve points of his strength.

It can be seen that I hate this ancient shield.

Bang!

With a loud bang, the ancient shield flew rapidly into the distance.

The boy did not stop and slipped away in the opposite direction.

Of course, the catastrophe cloud in the void followed closely in the direction of the young man.

The scene was silent for a moment, and a large amount of breath also headed towards the ancient shield.

The rest was to continue to follow the boy's direction.

"Qin Feng, Xiao Luo, you two go chase Gu Deng, I'll follow that kid."

"receive!"

"receive!"

Immediately, the three men divided into two groups.

Qin Feng and Xiao Luo went straight towards the ancient shield.

Lu Xue took Ao Qing to find the boy.
